title: AccessMap
summary: Expo/React Native app where disabled residents flag inaccessible paths, broken ramps, and missing curb cuts — then share fixes with their neighbourhood.

heroImage.alt: Warm-toned mockup of the AccessMap mobile interface showing accessibility flags pinned to a city map

title: Claude Corp
summary: A 14-role multi-agent system with a written Constitution governing how the team collaborates, plans, and ships safely.

heroImage.alt: A printed Constitution document on a linen surface beside a single terracotta-toned cup

title: Pac-Man Code Trainer
summary: CLI commands turned into a retro arcade game. Forty flashcards covering Claude Code and macOS shortcuts, zero dependencies, runs straight from GitHub Pages.

heroImage.alt: Retro arcade-style Pac-Man game interface with colorful dots and command flashcards on a dark background

title: Prompt Library
summary: A solo-built Next.js prompt manager with fifty shipped features, browser-only storage, and an API key that never leaves the user's machine.

heroImage.alt: A quiet workspace with a notebook of prompts open beside a laptop, soft natural light from the side

title: Mutual Mesh
summary: E2E-encrypted Expo app for mutual aid: neighbours post what they can share and what they need, matched privately without a central record of requests.

heroImage.alt: Two hands passing a small bundle across a kitchen table, soft window light from the left
